title: A Cold Morning
text:
Maria looks at the sky in the morning. It is cold and cloudy. She puts on a warm coat and a red scarf. She takes an umbrella too.

At noon, the sun comes out and the day gets warm. Maria takes off her coat and puts it in her bag. She wears her scarf around her neck. In the evening, it rains again.

questions.text: What does Maria do with her coat at noon?
options: She puts it in her bag
She gives it to a friend

questions.text: Why does Maria take an umbrella?
How does Maria probably feel at noon?

vocabulary.definition: a long warm piece of clothing worn outside
an object you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain
a piece of cloth worn around the neck to keep warm

paragraph_translations: María mira el cielo por la mañana. Hace frío y está nublado. Ella se pone un abrigo caliente y una bufanda roja. También lleva un paraguas.
Al mediodía, sale el sol y el día se pone cálido. María se quita el abrigo y lo guarda en su bolso. Lleva la bufanda alrededor del cuello. Por la noche, vuelve a llover.
